name: Russia
summary: Very harsh. Below a tiny 'significant amount' (e.g. 6 g cannabis, 0.2 g cocaine) possession or use is an administrative offence (fine or up to 15 days' jail; foreigners expelled). Above it: up to 3, 3–10 or 10–15 yrs.
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan protection. Hospitals report crime-linked injuries, so police may follow up; narcology registration is possible. Seeking treatment voluntarily avoids admin liability for use.
drugChecking: No drug checking services. Sharing drug information can be prosecuted as 'propaganda' (Code of Administrative Offences art. 6.13).

lsd.note: 'Significant amount' is 0.0001 g (0.1 mg) and whole mixtures can be weighed, so even one blotter can mean prosecution; 0.005 g is 'large' (3–10 yrs).

mushrooms.note: Under 10 g of mushroom (fruit body): admin fine RUB 4,000–5,000 or up to 15 days' arrest. 10 g+: crime (up to 3 yrs); 100 g+: 3–10 yrs.

dmt.note: Under 0.5 g: admin offence (fine or up to 15 days). Ayahuasca brew is weighed as a whole mixture, and B. caapi and harmala are also listed.

mescaline.note: Mescaline cacti are listed: 50 g of cactus (or 0.5 g mescaline) is already a crime (up to 3 yrs); 250 g+ is 'large' (3–10 yrs).

dox.note: DOB 'significant amount' is 0.01 g and whole blotters/mixtures can be weighed, so typical amounts are a crime (up to 3 yrs or more).

nbomes.note: NBOMe derivatives: 0.05 g counts as 'significant', weighed with the blotter/mixture, so typical amounts are a crime.

2c-x.note: 2C-x are listed as derivatives of 2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine: 0.05 g of powder or mixture is already a crime (up to 3 yrs).

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-7 is listed: 0.2 g is 'significant' (crime), 1 g is 'large' (3–10 yrs); mixtures are weighed whole.

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO-DMT is covered as a DMT derivative (crime from 0.5 g); 5-MeO-MiPT from just 0.05 g. Below that: admin fine or up to 15 days.

cannabis.note: Under 6 g herb / 2 g hashish: fine RUB 4,000–5,000 or up to 15 days; foreigners expelled. Above: crime (up to 3 yrs; 100 g+: 3–10 yrs). No medical use.

ketamine.note: Controlled anaesthetic. Without a prescription 0.2 g+ is a crime (up to 3 yrs) and 5 g+ is 'large' (3–10 yrs); less is an admin offence.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine and its derivatives are listed narcotics; small 'significant amounts' make most possession a crime.

dxm.note: Dextromethorphan is a List III psychotropic: prescription-only, and possession without one is an offence.

nitrous.note: Not a narcotic. Sale to individuals has been banned since 2021 and promoting recreational use is fined (RUB 1,000–2,000 for individuals).

amphetamines.note: Crime from 0.2 g amphetamine / 0.3 g methamphetamine; 1 g amphetamine is 'large' (3–10 yrs). No prescription amphetamines for ADHD.

mdma.note: Under 0.6 g (whole pill weight, about 1–2 pills): admin fine or up to 15 days. 0.6 g+: crime; 3 g+: 3–10 yrs.

cocaine.note: Crime from 0.2 g (up to 3 yrs); 1 g is already 'large' (3–10 yrs). Below 0.2 g: admin fine or up to 15 days' arrest.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale to minors is prohibited. Drinking in many public places is an administrative offence.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB and GBL are List III psychotropics: 10 g is 'significant' (crime), 50 g 'large' (3–10 yrs). A small bottle can exceed this.

opioids.note: Heroin: crime from 0.5 g (2.5 g = 3–10 yrs); methadone from 0.2 g. Morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl are strictly Rx; no opioid substitution therapy.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only 'potent substance': possessing it to sell is a crime (up to 3 yrs) and bringing it into Russia without papers can be smuggling.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only List III psychotropics. Without one, e.g. 1 g diazepam or 0.2 g clonazepam (tablet weight may count) is a crime.

maois.note: Harmine is a listed narcotic and Peganum harmala and B. caapi are listed plants: 3 g of plant is already a crime. Pharmaceutical MAOIs are Rx.
